query:
SELECT 
  r.category,
  COUNT(*) as total_impacts,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tri.transformation_id) as unique_transformations,
  COUNT(DISTINCT tri.recette_id) as unique_recipes,
  GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT r.name SEPARATOR ', ') as recipe_names
FROM transformation_recipe_impacts tri
JOIN recettes r ON tri.recette_id = r.id
GROUP BY r.category
ORDER BY total_impacts DESC;
